text:
The tenant's statutory period began when the widow died in 1986. Adverse possession runs from when the possession became hostile to the owner, not when the owner learned of it, so the Boy Scouts' 2009 discovery does not delay the clock, and the 20 years ran out around 2006. My earlier "one month after death" date is not one of the two options, but it is closer to the death date than to 2009.

CONFIDENCE: 60
